the combination of unilateral UUO with a high-salt diet leads to a more pronounced renal phenotype than unilateral UUO alone in adult rats.
the renal insufficiency that occurs in adult rats after unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO) in neonates is associated with a reduction in renal mass and function.

the effects of unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO) in newborn rats.
